install.notes: The clone is not a pip package: it is run from its directory after Isaac Sim 5.0.0.0 and Isaac Lab 0.54.3 are installed into a Python 3.11 venv (JAZZY.md:61-69), and the task needs a GPU. The gate and the fake backend need none of that: fake.py is pure Python and the gate never installs or imports the upstream code. The sim backend (gymnasium.make of the registered task) was not run.
